reviewedBy: human review of the run log (aborted before the gate)
notes: Infrastructure failure, not an agent failure: the laptop lid was closed at 21:56, three minutes into the Write-tests call, and the Mac slept until 22:28 (pmset log). The API stream died during sleep and the CLI call never returned; the pipeline's 15-minute timeout used a monotonic clock that stops during sleep, so it never fired.
Stopped by hand after about 37 minutes by killing the hung claude -p process (exit 143); the pipeline then recorded the failure and returned to main cleanly.
Fixed in the pipeline afterwards: the CLI deadline is now wall-clock time and a failed model call gets the same single retry as invalid JSON.
